# appgatesdp_site (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Data sources look objects up by id or by exact name.
data "appgatesdp_site" "by_name" {
  name = "Default Site"
}

data "appgatesdp_site" "by_id" {
  id = "4c07bc67-57ea-42dd-b702-c2d6c45419fc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `default_gateway` (Attributes) Default Gateway configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_gateway))
- `description` (String) Description of the Site to be displayed on the Client.
- `entitlement_based_routing` (Boolean) When enabled, the routes are sent to the Client by the Gateways according to the user's Entitlements "networkSubnets" should be left be empty if it's enabled.
- `fallback_site` (String) When the Client fails to connect to the Site for a certain period of time, configured Entitlements (see Policy) will be moved to this "Fallback" Site.
- `geolocation` (Attributes) Geolocation of the Site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--geolocation))
- `ip_pool_mappings` (Attributes List) List of IP Pool mappings for this specific Site. When IPs are allocated this Site, they will be mapped to a new one using this setting. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_pool_mappings))
- `local_site_detection` (Attributes) Local Site Detection feature settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--local_site_detection))
- `name_resolution` (Attributes) Settings for asset name resolution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution))
- `network_subnets` (List of String) Network subnets in CIDR format to define the Site's boundaries. They are added as routes by the Client. Comments are supported with "#" delimiter.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `short_name` (String) A short 4 letter name for the Site to be displayed on the Client. Deprecated as of 6.4 since 6.4 Client does not display this anymore. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
- `use_for_nearest_site_selection` (Boolean) If enabled, this Site will be included in the nearest Site override selection in Policies.
- `vpn` (Attributes) VPN configuration for this Site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn))

<a id="nestedatt--default_gateway"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_gateway`

Read-Only:

- `enabled_v4` (Boolean) When enabled, the Client uses this Site as the Default Default for all IPV4 traffic.
- `enabled_v6` (Boolean) When enabled, the Client uses this Site as the Default Default for all IPv6 traffic.
- `excluded_subnets` (List of String) Network subnets to exclude when Default Gateway is enabled. The traffic for these subnets will not go through the Gateway in this Site. Comments are supported with "#" delimiter.


<a id="nestedatt--geolocation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `geolocation`

Read-Only:

- `latitude` (Number)
- `longitude` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--ip_pool_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_pool_mappings`

Read-Only:

- `from` (String) IP Pool ID to map from. If a user is authorizing with this IP Pool via Identity Provider assignment and has access to this Site, mapping will occur for that user.
- `to` (String) IP Pool ID to map to.
- `type` (String) Mapping type.


<a id="nestedatt--local_site_detection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `local_site_detection`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables the Local Site Detection feature.
- `public_ips` (List of String) The public IPs or the CIDRs of the clients that will be considered local to this Site.  Those clients will connect to Gateways with the configured local hostname and local weights in Appliance configuration.


<a id="nestedatt--name_resolution"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_resolution`

Read-Only:

- `aws_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolvers to resolve Amazon machines by querying Amazon Web Services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--aws_resolvers))
- `azure_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolvers to resolve Azure machines by querying Azure App Service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--azure_resolvers))
- `claroty_ctd_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolvers to resolve names by querying a Claroty CTD server. Requires the Operational Technology licensed feature. Supported in API versions: v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--claroty_ctd_resolvers))
- `color_tokens_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolvers to resolve names by querying ColorTokens. Supported in API versions: v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--color_tokens_resolvers))
- `dns_forwarding` (Attributes) DNS Forwarding feature. Always enabled and will be filled if there is no object is passed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--dns_forwarding))
- `dns_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolver to resolve hostnames using DNS servers. If there are no DNS Resolvers with empty match domains, one will be added automatically. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--dns_resolvers))
- `esx_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolvers to resolve VMware vSphere machines by querying the vCenter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--esx_resolvers))
- `gcp_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolvers to resolve GCP machine by querying Google web services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--gcp_resolvers))
- `illumio_resolvers` (Attributes List) Resolvers to resolve names by querying Appgate Illumio Resolver. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--illumio_resolvers))
- `use_hosts_file` (Boolean) Name resolution to use Appliance's /etc/hosts file.

<a id="nestedatt--name_resolution--aws_resolvers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_resolution.aws_resolvers`

Read-Only:

- `access_key_id` (String) ID of the access key.
- `api_gateway` (Boolean) Resolve API Gateway resources. Supported in API versions: v23, v24, v25.
- `assumed_roles` (Attributes List) Roles to be assumed to perform AWS name resolution. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--aws_resolvers--assumed_roles))
- `ec2` (Boolean) Resolve EC2 resources. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `eks` (Boolean) Resolve EKS resources. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `https_proxy` (String) Proxy address to use while communicating with AWS. format: https://username:password@ip/hostname:port
- `name` (String) Identifier name. Has no functional effect.
- `partition` (String) What AWS partition to use such as 'aws-cn' or 'aws-us-gov'
- `rds` (Boolean) Resolve RDS resources. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `regions` (List of String) Amazon regions.
- `resolve_with_master_credentials` (Boolean) Use master credentials to resolve names in addition to any assumed roles.
- `update_interval` (Number) How often will the resolver poll the server. In seconds.
- `use_iamrole` (Boolean) Uses the built-in IAM role in AWS instances to authenticate against the API.
- `vpc_auto_discovery` (Boolean) Use VPC auto discovery.
- `vpcs` (List of String) VPC IDs to resolve names.

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--name_resolution--dns_forwarding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_resolution.dns_forwarding`

Read-Only:

- `allow_destinations` (Attributes List) A list of subnets to allow access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_resolution--dns_forwarding--allow_destinations))
- `auto_client_dns` (Boolean) This will configure Client machines' DNS according to this forwarder if the Client connects to this Site. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `default_ttl_seconds` (Number) Deprecated as of 6.4. This will apply whenever Gateway gets a DNS response which has no TTL set. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS Servers to use for resolving endpoints. Leave it empty to use the Gateways' own DNS configuration.
- `match_domains` (List of String) The match domains to use for automatic Client DNS configuration. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `site_ipv4` (String) DNS Forwarder Site IPv4 address.
- `site_ipv6` (String) DNS Forwarder Site IPv6 address.

<a id="nestedatt--name_resolution--dns_forwarding--allow_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_resolution.dns_forwarding.allow_destinations`

Read-Only:

- `netmask` (Number) netmask



<a id="nestedatt--name_resolution--dns_resolvers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_resolution.dns_resolvers`

Read-Only:

- `auto_client_dns` (Boolean) This will configure Client machines' DNS according to this resolver if the Client connects to this Site.
- `default_ttl_seconds` (Number) Deprecated as of 6.4. This will apply whenever Gateway gets a DNS response which has no TTL set. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `match_domains` (List of String) The DNS resolver will only attempt to resolve names matching the match domains. If match domains are not specified the DNS resolver will attempt to resolve all hostnames.
- `name` (String) Identifier name. Has no functional effect.
- `query_aaaa` (Boolean) Perform AAAA lookups.
- `servers` (List of String) DNS Server addresses that will be used to resolve hostnames within the Site. Leave it empty to use the Gateways' own DNS configuration.
- `update_interval` (Number) How often will the resolver poll the server. In seconds.
- `zones_transfers` (Boolean) Perform zones transfer.
